description: Sentinel-1 SAR-based monthly flood extent detection for Eastern DRC (North Kivu, South Kivu, Ituri). Produces calibrated sigma0 dB composites, change-detection flood masks, admin-level sampling frames, and researcher handover packages.

features.name: core-pipeline
features.description: STAC discovery → SAR preprocessing → flood detection → validation charts → sampling frames

features.name: handover-package
features.description: Researcher handover: GeoJSON flood extents, admin-2/3 + H3-7 parquets, CSVs, interactive Folium maps

features.name: geosql-integration
features.description: Integrate dekart-xyz/geosql to enable AI-driven spatial SQL queries over flood data warehouses (BigQuery / PostGIS), with automatic metadata discovery and cost guardrails

features.name: may-july-2026-extension
